examples.en: Mitch was a San Franciscan by birth.
examples.zh: 米奇是在旧金山出生的。

examples.en: He is called Mitch, because his name is Mitchell.
examples.zh: 他被叫做米奇，因为他的名字是米切尔。

examples.en: It has seemed unable to have what Indiana Governor Mitch Daniels has called an "adult conversation" about the consequences of spending so much more than is taken in.
examples.zh: 像印第安纳州州长米奇·丹尼尔斯所说的那样，就过度消费的后果展开“成人对话”，似乎是不可能的。
